user.title: Set up Android Device Control
user.description: Add friendly actions for Android devices registered through the Home Assistant Companion App. No device mapping is required.

ringtone.name: Ringtone
ringtone.description: Use the default alarm sound, silence, or a custom content URI.

alarm_label.description: Required only for Alarm with label.
